question: How many days do I have to return a product?
expected_answer: You can return most products within 14 days of delivery, unused and in original packaging.

question: What is the return window for shoes?
expected_answer: Footwear can be returned within 10 days of delivery, unworn and in the original box.

question: Can I return headphones I've already opened?
expected_answer: Opened headphones and earbuds can be returned only if they are faulty, for hygiene reasons.

question: How long do I have to return a phone?
expected_answer: Electronics can be returned within 7 days of delivery, only if unopened, unless faulty or damaged.

question: How long does a refund take after the pickup?
expected_answer: The refund reaches your original payment method within 5 to 7 working days of pickup.

question: Where will my refund be credited?
expected_answer: Refunds go to the original payment method: the same UPI account, card or bank account; COD refunds to a bank account you add.

question: Can I return something I bought in the clearance sale?
expected_answer: Clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned for change of mind; a defective clearance item can be exchanged within the category window.

question: I bought a TV in the sale and now the price has dropped. Can I get the difference back?
expected_answer: No. Items bought in a sale are not eligible for a price-drop refund.
expected: sale items are not eligible for a price-drop refund

question: Do you refund the difference if a price drops after I buy?
expected_answer: Yes, if the price drops within 7 days of delivery, once per order, while you still have the product. Sale and clearance items are excluded.

question: What is the delivery charge on a ₹799 order to Kochi?
expected_answer: ₹49. Kochi is an 'other city', and orders of ₹499 and above pay ₹49 there.

question: Is delivery free for a ₹799 order in Pune?
expected_answer: Yes. Pune is a metro city, and orders of ₹499 and above are delivered free.

question: What is the delivery charge for orders below ₹499?
expected_answer: Below ₹499: ₹49 in metro cities and ₹79 in other cities.

question: Above what amount is delivery free everywhere?
expected_answer: Orders of ₹2,999 and above are delivered free in all cities.

question: What time do you deliver?
expected_answer: Between 9 am and 9 pm, Monday to Saturday. Sunday delivery only for Express orders in metro cities.

question: How much does express delivery cost?
expected_answer: Express costs ₹99 extra: next day in metro cities, 2–3 days elsewhere.

question: Can I change my delivery address after the order has shipped?
expected_answer: Not online. After dispatch a support agent can ask the courier to redirect it, but it is not guaranteed and needs a person to approve.

question: How many times will the courier try to deliver?
expected_answer: Three attempts on three working days; then the parcel returns to the warehouse and the order is cancelled.

question: My order shows delivered but I didn't get it. How long do I have to report it?
expected_answer: Report it within 48 hours of the delivery time shown.
section_title: Marked as delivered but not received

question: Can I cancel an order that has already shipped?
expected_answer: No. Refuse the delivery at the door, or accept it and return it within the return window.

question: Is there a fee to cancel an order?
expected_answer: No. Orders can be cancelled free until they are shipped.

question: I cancelled my order ten days ago and still don't have my refund. What should I do?
expected_answer: If it hasn't arrived within seven working days, raise a ticket in Help → Refunds with the UPI reference number.

question: Who approves refunds above ₹5,000?
expected_answer: Any refund above ₹5,000 needs a human: a support lead approves it, usually within 1 working day.

question: How long do UPI refunds take?
expected_answer: UPI refunds take 5–7 working days after the refund is started.

question: I was charged twice for one order. When will I get the extra money back?
expected_answer: The extra charge is reversed automatically within 5–7 working days. Raise a ticket if it hasn't come back after 7 working days.

question: What is the maximum order value for cash on delivery?
expected_answer: COD is available for orders up to ₹10,000.

question: Is there a charge for cash on delivery?
expected_answer: Yes, a ₹30 COD fee.

question: How do I get my refund for a COD order?
expected_answer: Add a bank account in My Orders → Refund details; it's sent by NEFT within 5–7 working days after the details are verified, or as gift card balance within 24 hours.

question: What is the minimum order for EMI?
expected_answer: Card EMI is available on orders of ₹3,000 and above.

question: My UPI payment is showing pending. Should I pay again?
expected_answer: No. Wait 30 minutes; the order is confirmed or the money is reversed automatically.

question: How long is the warranty on a phone?
expected_answer: Mobile phones have a 1-year manufacturer warranty, handled by the brand service centre.

question: Do I need my bill for a phone warranty claim?
expected_answer: Yes, phone claims need the original invoice. You can download it from My Orders → Invoice.

question: My phone screen cracked after I dropped it. Is that covered by warranty?
expected_answer: No. Physical damage after delivery, like a cracked screen from a drop, is not covered by warranty.

question: Until when can I buy an extended warranty?
expected_answer: ShopKart Protect can be bought within 30 days of delivery.

question: What do I need to send for a damaged item?
expected_answer: A clear photo of the damage and a photo of the shipping label.

question: How soon will I hear back about my damaged item?
expected_answer: The refunds team replies to every damaged-item request within 48 hours.

question: How long do I have to report damaged groceries?
expected_answer: Grocery damage must be reported within 48 hours of delivery.

question: I opened my laptop box and the screen is cracked. Can I still return it even though it's opened?
expected_answer: Yes. Damaged or defective electronics can be returned within 7 days of delivery even if the box was opened.
expected: damaged items can be returned even if opened

question: Is a size exchange for shoes free?
expected_answer: Yes, the first size exchange is free; a second one on the same item has a ₹49 pickup fee.

question: My clearance shoes have a split sole. What can I do?
expected_answer: Clearance shoes are final sale, but a defect can be exchanged within 10 days of delivery; refund only if no replacement is available.

question: My new shoes squeak when I walk. Is that a defect?
expected_answer: A little noise in the first day or two is normal. Sole noise that doesn't stop counts as a defect: report it within 10 days with a short video.
expected: normal for the first few days
persistent sole noise is a defect

question: How long is a ShopKart gift card valid?
expected_answer: Gift cards are valid for 1 year.

question: Can I buy a gift card with cash on delivery?
expected_answer: No. Gift cards can't be bought with COD, EMI or another gift card.

question: Can I use my gift card together with cash on delivery?
expected_answer: No. A gift card can be combined only with UPI, card or net banking.

question: Can I get a refund on a gift card?
expected_answer: No. Gift cards are not refundable or exchangeable for cash.

question: How do I delete my account?
expected_answer: Account → Privacy → Delete account. Data is deleted within 30 days, except records the law requires.
section_title: Customer rights under the DPDP Act

question: How long do you keep my chat history?
expected_answer: Support chats are kept for 90 days, then deleted.

question: You match lower prices, right?
expected_answer: No. ShopKart does not match prices; the programme ended on 27 October 2026.

question: Can I use the Diwali coupon on EMI?
expected_answer: DIWALI10 could be used with EMI, but it was valid only from 15 October to 2 November 2026, so it can't be used now.

question: Can I return a lipstick I opened?
expected_answer: No. Beauty products can be returned within 7 days only if unopened.

question: What are your support hours?
expected_answer: 9 am to 9 pm IST, Monday to Saturday; toll-free 1800-120-7575.
